description: Repair broken MCP: a tool call fails, a server reports "Connection closed", tools that used to exist are gone, a project moved or its venv was rebuilt, junk breaks the stdio stream, or a server answers from the CLI but not from the session. Method: split client / server / environment first, then walk a 5-step ladder (real name → status → logs → CLI reproduction → stdio probe) and fix by category. Use for any "MCP is broken", "the browser tool is not called", "everything broke after the move".
